variant.author: pupwife
variant.changelog:
- Now featuring dye statistics!
  - Find (or, well, try to) the correct dye for each slot.
  - Uses a weighting system to determine which dyes are correct.
  - View the confidence rating for each dye. Automically sorted by accuracy in descending order.
  - Actually not all that accurate currently, so take it with a big grain of salt and refer to more reliable sources.
- Changed the UI layout to accommodate the new dye windows.
- More refactoring.
variant.description: Analyze your Glamour Dresser for shared models!
variant.name: Dispeller
variant.punchline: Easily clean out your Glamour Dresser.
